reason: A DeepSeek Harness integration plugin that connects to MCP servers, exposes their tools, and embeds MCP App interfaces in the conversation UI.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 MCP 服务器，提供工具调用并在对话界面中嵌入 MCP 应用界面。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to MCP servers, exposes their tools, and embeds MCP App interfaces in the conversation UI.

capabilities: Connects to MCP servers over Streamable HTTP
Registers MCP tools for model and app use
Renders MCP App HTML resources in sandboxed iframes
Supports tool calls and resource reads through an RPC bridge
Can pass configured headers and environment variables to MCP server connections
